task.title: Define RED tests for CLI profiles and mutual contact trust
task.description: Create failing Vitest specifications for strict CLI profile configuration, encrypted identity persistence, signed-bundle contact export/import, and mutual Signal identity pinning before messaging.
task.scope: new apps/cli tests and fixtures only

acceptance_criteria: A profile initializes once with stable Echolet/device/Signal identities and rejects a wrong 32-byte store key without replacement.
Configuration rejects unknown fields, malformed keys, and non-loopback plain HTTP relay URLs.
Contact export conforms to the reviewed schema and contains a complete signed Signal bundle v2.
Contact import validates root/device/native signatures, requires explicit confirmation, and pins the exact remote Signal identity.
Both peers can import and pin each other before messaging; changed identities and invalid signatures leave trust unchanged.
Secrets and plaintext are absent from normal command results and diagnostics.
constraints: Load and follow tests-creator and the project testing skill; preserve RED-before-GREEN evidence.
Do not edit flow.json or acceptance-criteria.md.
Do not modify apps/relay or packages/protocol; another worker owns that scope.
Use keryx ctx rg for searches and apply_patch for file edits.
Do not commit: this repository has an unborn untracked baseline, so partial root commits are forbidden.
Write a valid subagent-result to .metaproject/flows/001-2026-09-05-echolet-assessment-fixes/dispatches/001-T23-tests-result.json and make the final response start with STATUS:.

provenance.source_request: Implement the approved Echolet CLI prototype through flow-orchestrator.
